issues.text: Explanations drop the condition that sec 4 and claim 12 now carry: only GitHub-hosted runners are discarded after the job; self-hosted runners persist. The stem says only "on its runner". Key a and the wrong options stay correct either way.
issues.quote: But each runner is discarded after its job
issues.fix: Stem en: "A GitHub Actions job builds the API image on a GitHub-hosted runner." (vi: "trên một runner do GitHub cung cấp"). Or in explanations correct/c write "each GitHub-hosted runner" / "runner do GitHub cung cấp".

issues.text: Round-2 gap is fixed: the name rule is now just "starts with the registry's host", which I learned in Core concepts. But two sentences in a row now point forward ("the next lessons use..." then "The lessons after this one do that from CI."), so I briefly wondered whether they are different lessons.
issues.quote: the next lessons use a name that starts with the registry's host. The lessons after this one do that from CI.
issues.fix: Merge into one sentence: "...then pulled; the next lessons do that from CI, with a name that starts with the registry's host."

issues.text: The new clause makes option c clearly wrong, so b vs c is now decidable from the context. But it is joined to the unrelated "several fixed versions" idea with "and ... but", making the last sentence long; I re-read it to find the rule that matters.
